desc:
KIDAA : Indian Horror

Enter a mysterious Tamil village where something feels terribly wrong. Explore dark and unfamiliar places, uncover hidden secrets, and try to survive the things waiting in the shadows.

KIDAA is our first experimental horror project, inspired by Indian village stories, local atmosphere, and the kind of horror that makes you afraid of what might be hiding just around the corner.

Expect:

🌑 Tamil village atmosphere
👻 Original horror elements
🏚️ Mysterious locations and secrets
🎮 Story-driven gameplay
😨 Increasing horror and tension
🔦 Exploration and survival

This game is still an experimental project made by beginner developers, so your feedback means a lot to us.

Can you survive KIDAA?
